Run tab

Source: R/run_tab.R
kit_run_tab_ui.Rd

Page skeleton for a tab with one primary button. kit_run_tab_ui() lays out the fixed parts following the page skeleton; the tab's own settings go in .... kit_run_tab_server() is called inside the tab's moduleServer() and handles the status flow:

Usage

kit_run_tab_ui(
  id,
  run_label,
  guide = NULL,
  ...,
  gate = TRUE,
  result = FALSE,
  downloads = TRUE,
  details = TRUE,
  code = TRUE,
  next_step = FALSE
)

kit_run_tab_server(
  input,
  output,
  session,
  run_label,
  run,
  done = NULL,
  ready = NULL,
  ready_link = function() NULL,
  settings = NULL,
  stale_on = NULL,
  progress = NULL,
  error = function(e) kit_error_status(e, run_label),
  guard = NULL,
  confirm = list(),
  result_ui = NULL,
  details_ui = NULL,
  code = NULL,
  code_note = KIT_CODE_NOTE
)

Arguments

id

The tab (module) id.

run_label

The primary button's text (start with a verb, for example "執行串接", "Run join").

guide

The "what this page does" at the top (kit_tab_guide()).

...

The tab's own settings (inputs, hints), placed above the settings summary.

gate

TRUE: the primary button starts disabled, with the "還差" ("Still needed") line above it; FALSE: always clickable (no ready).

result, downloads, next_step

The key results below the status box, the download area, and the next step at the very bottom: TRUE is a uiOutput() (ids result, downloads, next_step); you can also pass a tag directly; FALSE leaves it out.

details

Details row: TRUE adds uiOutput("result_details") (preview and checks of the result); when both details and code are FALSE, there is no details row.

code

UI (kit_run_tab_ui()): TRUE adds "用 R 怎麼做" ("How to do it in R") (kit_code_panel(), output code). Server (kit_run_tab_server()): a function that returns the code (the code of kit_render_code_panel()); with NULL, the tab renders it itself.

input, output, session

The input, output, and session of the tab's moduleServer().

run

The function that runs: returns the result (any object), or a kit_status() (no result; for example, a problem must be handled first). To stop, call kit_abort() (with a plain-language reason).

done

function(result): the status after running (kit_done_status()); the result is already saved before it is called.

ready

A reactive: what is still needed (character vector; length 0 = ready to run); with NULL, there is no "還差" line (gate = FALSE).

ready_link

A function: the link after "還差" (a tag or NULL).

settings

A function: the parts of the settings summary (character vector; NULL shows nothing); with NULL, there is no settings summary.

stale_on

A function: things whose change makes the result out of date (for example list(input$method, data())); with NULL, the tab handles this itself (using the returned result and status).

progress

The progress bar message ("正在串接資料…", "Joining data…"); with NULL, there is no progress bar.

error

function(e): the status on error; defaults to kit_error_status(e, run_label).

guard

A function: a check before running; when it returns a kit_status(), nothing runs (status box and notification, no scrolling); NULL skips the check.

confirm

Errors the user must confirm: a named list; names are condition classes, values are function(e). It opens a confirmation dialog and returns a status (no notification, no scrolling; the dialog is the response). After confirming, run again with the returned run(...).

result_ui

function(result): the key results below the status box (output result); with NULL, the tab renders it itself.

details_ui

function(result): the first cell of the details row (output result_details, for example kit_detail() "結果預覽", "Result preview"); with NULL, the tab renders it itself.

code_note

The one-line note at the top of "用 R 怎麼做".

Value

kit_run_tab_ui(): a tagList().

kit_run_tab_server(): a list,

  • result: a reactiveVal, the result of this run (NULL when there is none yet or it is out of date);

  • status: a reactiveVal, the status box's kit_status();

  • state: a reactive, the status box's state (used for the ✓ on step tabs, kit_tab_states());

  • run(...): runs once, just like pressing the primary button (... goes to run(); for example "仍要執行", "Run anyway", in a confirmation dialog).

Details

  • Primary button: disabled while something is still needed (ready() is not empty), with a "還差：…" ("Still needed: …") line above it (kit_run_gate()).

  • Settings summary: the parts of settings() joined into one line (kit_settings_line()).

  • Pressing the primary button: clear the old result → guard() → run() inside a progress bar → save the result, done(result) is the status; on error, error(e) is the status → status box, notification (kit_notify()), scroll to the status box (kit_scroll_to()).

  • When settings or data change (stale_on() changes) and there is a result: the result is cleared and the status is 【要重新執行】 ("Run again").

  • Key results, the first cell of the details row, and "How to do it in R": rendered only when there is a result.

Fixed output ids (without namespace): settings_line, ready, run (the button), status, result, downloads, result_details, code, next_step.

See also

kit_run_gate(), kit_status(), kit_code_panel()

Examples

if (interactive()) {
  mod_stack_ui <- function(id) {
    kit_run_tab_ui(
      id, "執行疊加",
      guide = kit_tab_guide("把各波資料上下疊起來。", c("按「執行疊加」", "看狀態框與預覽"), "一張長格式的資料。"),
      shiny::numericInput(shiny::NS(id, "n"), "幾個波次", 2),
      downloads = FALSE
    )
  }
  mod_stack_server <- function(id) {
    shiny::moduleServer(id, function(input, output, session) {
      tab <- kit_run_tab_server(
        input, output, session, "執行疊加",
        ready = shiny::reactive(if (input$n < 2) "至少 2 個波次"),
        settings = function() paste0(input$n, " 個波次"),
        stale_on = function() input$n,
        progress = "正在疊加資料…",
        run = function() data.frame(wave = seq_len(input$n)),
        done = function(res) kit_done_status(paste0("疊加完成：", nrow(res), " 列。")),
        details = function(res) kit_detail("結果預覽", kit_static_table(res)),
        code = function() "stacked <- dplyr::bind_rows(t1, t2, .id = \"wave\")"
      )
      list(state = tab$state)
    })
  }
  shiny::shinyApp(kit_page("KIT 示範", NULL, mod_stack_ui("stack")),
                  function(input, output, session) mod_stack_server("stack"))
}
